Cross-period single-variable evidence

Holdout period is excluded from training gate and rank. Original variable names are preserved.

Same-security lag term structure

Every point is an independently tested official Top/Worst raw variable. Different lags are alternatives, not stacked components.

Period winners are descriptive rotation evidence. They are not selected with information available before that same holdout.

Single-variable period map

N/A means there were not enough real benchmark snapshots and portfolio formations to validate the signal.

Special period leaders

A combination is called synergy only when its official pair/subset evidence beats the stronger leg and leave-one-out or historical holdout evidence confirms the contribution.

Official pair / subset evidence

Includes every passed lag6 variable crossed with every non-empty subset of independently passed EPS Revision Ratio, PMOM 12M1M, and EPS Growth FY1 anchors.

Strict historical holdout synergy

Weak, additive, redundant, and harmful evidence remains visible.

Signal-data availability

NAV continuity alone is not factor validation.

Deflated Sharpe

Trial-count penalty uses all documented candidates recoverable for the market.
